items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...It says, “In Philadelphia he worked with Cal Massey, Jimmy Garrison, and Albert ‘Tootie’ Heath...” [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I think it must have been a club...

ctx.x: Did they say where it was?

Well, it would have been in Philly but it doesn’t say anything else. It says, “In Philadelphia he worked with Cal Massey, Jimmy Garrison, and Albert ‘Tootie’ Heath [and that] in 1957 this group had a week-long engagement with John Coltrane with whom Tyner regularly rehearsed.”
Yeah, I think it must have been a club for it to be a week-long because John and Calvin were very close; they were tight. I’m trying to remember because they had various clubs.
